texts.lineage: This app belongs to the NereusSDR project. Its desktop and Core software draws on Thetis, a PowerSDR fork associated with MW0LGE; AetherSDR supplied architectural patterns for Qt 6 and C++20; and WDSP supplies desktop/Core digital signal processing. The phone app is written natively and does not bundle code from those projects.
texts.desktopLibraries: The desktop/Core distribution includes the WDSP v1.29 DSP engine and FFTW3 for spectrum calculations, with Qt 6 for its interface, networking and audio. It also uses DeepFilterNet, libdatachannel, libjuice, libspecbleach, libsrtp, nlohmann json, OpenSSL, Opus, plog, PortAudio, r8brain, RADE, rnnoise, usrsctp and zlib. Consult that distribution for their licence texts.

The desktop/Core LICENSE, its dual-licensing document (limited to Samphire / MW0LGE contributions), and individual file headers state the authoritative terms.
texts.aiDisclosure: AI-assisted authoring with Anthropic Claude Code helped translate portions of the desktop/Core source from Thetis C# and AetherSDR Qt 6/C++. The affected source headers identify those translations. This phone app is a native implementation.
